subtechniques.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
subtechniques.description: A web application firewall is a specific form of application firewall that filters, monitors, and blocks HTTP traffic to and from a web service. By inspecting HTTP traffic, it can prevent attacks exploiting a web application's known vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, file inclusion, and improper system configuration

procedures.name: WAF -> RPROXY1 -> RPROXY2 -> VPN -> Backend
procedures.description: This is a recommended setup for hosting a secure and resilient onion service. The WAF combined with double reversed proxies prevents the backend from ending up on famous services such as Shodan or Censys.
